$comment: Cross-language conformance fixture for the run comparison (issue #2127). Read by the app's vitest suite (app/electron/mcp/compare.conformance.test.ts, which replays every case through BOTH app/electron/mcp/compare.ts and app/src/lib/run-compare.ts) and by the engine gtest suite (engine/tests/run_export_test.cpp, via VAYU_ENGINE_SOURCE_DIR, through vayu::core::compare_run_reports). `expected` is compareReports' answer less the two run ids; the engine writes its `comparability` as `differences[]` ({field: code, base, target}, no message) and its `latency`, `throughput` and `reliability` as one `deltas[]` in that order. A case whose input JSON cannot spell (NaN, Infinity) stays inline in the app test.
